provenance.post_title: PACG Cutting Room Floor: Wondrous Rod
provenance.asset_description: Display to shuffle a new weapon, spell, armor, item, ally, and blessing into a facedown stack next to this card; do not look at them. While displayed:When a character encounters a bane or a boon, you may flip over the top card of the stack. During the encounter, you may play it; at the end of the encounter, banish it. At the start of your turn, recharge this card and banish the stack.
